blockers.target: FormalSystem.Semantics.exists_coneUnravelling_of_constraints (and the coneFrameOfSerial / coneF_twoWayBounded_of_constraints assembly it depends on)
blockers.verbatim_goal: exists_coneUnravelling_of_constraints (F : FrameOver intOrder) (hcomp : TaskFrame.Compositional F.TaskRel) (hser : TaskFrame.Serial F.TaskRel) (hlim : TaskFrame.Limit F.TaskRel) (M : TaskModel F.toTaskFrame) : a frame over intOrder carrying only Compositionality, Seriality and Limit has a regular cone-unravelling frame with surjective, two-way bounded projection, along which L-plus truth transfers.
blockers.what_was_tried: 1. Reading base Saturation off F -- unavailable: a bare FrameOver carries no frame axiom (TaskFrame.lean:1072 structure FrameOver vs :1189 class IsRegular). 2. Deriving base Saturation from hcomp/hser/hlim -- refuted by FrameConstraintIndependence.lean's constraints_pairwise_independent, third conjunct, the rayRel witness over Z that satisfies C+S+L and refutes Saturation. 3. Deriving the cone's Saturation structurally as UniversalCover.lean does -- impossible: IsOrientedForest (coneR E) is false, since the inl layer is a verbatim copy of E and inherits its loops and opposite edges; only the inr layer is a forest, which is why Saturation had to be split in two. 4. Checking whether base Saturation is merely convenient -- it is necessary: at E := (fun w u => w <= u) on Z the family {Fib (ofStepRel (coneR E)) (.inl w) 1 | w : Z} is directed, has nonempty IsFiber members, and has empty intersection.
blockers.why_it_failed: FrameOver.ofStepSat demands TaskFrame.Saturation (ofStepRel (coneR F.step)); the only route to it, saturation_coneR, demands TaskFrame.Saturation (ofStepRel F.step), which hser does not supply. The pinned statement is satisfiable only by delegating to UniversalCover.lean's exists_orientedForest_cover_of_constraints, whose existential witness is the cover and not the cone -- a proof that would pass every name, sorry and axiom check while asserting nothing about this module. rules/plan-compliance.md's Statement Fidelity section forbids adding a hypothesis to a recorded Challenge statement, or quietly editing the recorded Challenge, without raising it. Resolution options (a) thread hsat : TaskFrame.Saturation F.TaskRel through coneFrameOfSerialSat / coneF_twoWayBounded_of_constraints / exists_coneUnravelling_of_constraints, or (b) state the headline only in the instance-projected coneFrame (F) [F.IsRegular] / exists_coneUnravelling (F) [F.IsRegular] form.
